query:
SELECT
            COALESCE(SUM(size_bytes), 0)::BIGINT as "total_size_bytes!",
            COALESCE(SUM(row_count), 0)::BIGINT as "total_row_count!",
            COALESCE(
                SUM(COALESCE(arrow_size_bytes, size_bytes))
                    / NULLIF(SUM(row_count), 0),
                0
            )::BIGINT as "avg_bytes_per_row!"
        FROM chunk_t
        WHERE topic_id = $1
